csv_scope_of_work: Tompkins Consolidated Area Transit, Inc. (TCAT) is issuing this Request for Proposals (RFP) to solicit responses from qualified firms to provide professional Architecture and Engineering (A&E) services. The intent of this RFP is to establish a relationship with a firm capable of supporting TCAT in the planning, design, engineering, and execution of multiple facility improvement and replacement projects. TCAT will make an award based on qualifications, technical merit.

services: Professional architecture and engineering services including architecture, landscape architecture, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, inspection services, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- General on-call A&E services for unspecified transit facilities rather than a defined structural project.
- Includes structural and civil engineering, but also many non-core disciplines.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or complex building is identified.
- Framework/multi-project character with limited technical definition reduces strategic fit.
- Transit depot or facility work could be mildly relevant, but the notice gives no concrete structural opportunity.

fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the tender documents. As this is an on-call multi-project A&E services procurement with undefined future assignments, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms capable of providing professional A&E services for multiple facility improvement and replacement projects; award based on qualifications and technical merit. No detailed minimum reference counts or specific qualification thresholds are stated in the provided notice.
award_criteria: Award based on qualifications and technical merit.
